featuredProducts.name: Tile Adhesive (Semi-Flexible)
featuredProducts.description: A polymer-modified cementitious adhesive for fixing interior and exterior ceramic tiles, available in grey or white.
highlights: Extended open time with good slip resistance
typicalUses: General-purpose interior and exterior wall and floor tiling
Ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, reconstituted and selected natural stone tiles
MiC factory production and on-site installation

featuredProducts.name: Tile Adhesive (Flexible)
featuredProducts.description: A high-polymer, high-strength flexible adhesive developed for interior and exterior wall and floor tile installations.
highlights: Designed for large and heavy tiles
typicalUses: Interior and exterior wall and floor tiling
Large and heavy ceramic, homogeneous and selected natural stone tiles
MiC factory production and on-site installation

featuredProducts.name: Tile Grout (High Performance)
featuredProducts.description: A decorative polymer-modified cementitious grout for strong, hard-wearing and water-resistant tile joints.
highlights: Rigid, durable and waterproof surface finish
typicalUses: Interior and exterior wall and floor tile joints
Joint widths from 1 mm to 15 mm across three texture grades
Potable water tanks, swimming pools and MiC applications

featuredProducts.name: Waterproofing Slurry (Semi-Flexible)
featuredProducts.description: A fast-drying two-part polymer-cement composite coating that forms a semi-flexible waterproofing membrane.
highlights: Semi-flexible membrane with strong substrate adhesion
typicalUses: Wet rooms, balconies, roofs and other tiled waterproofing systems
Concrete and cementitious substrates requiring a seamless membrane
Areas where vapour permeability and adhesion to damp surfaces are important

featuredProducts.name: Repair Mortar (High Performance Rapid Setting)
featuredProducts.description: A polymer-modified, shrinkage-compensated mortar for rapid concrete repair with high early strength and substantial vertical build.
highlights: Up to 35 mm vertical build per layer
typicalUses: Rapid repair of concrete surfaces, edges and local defects
Vertical and overhead repair where high build is required
Repairs requiring rapid return to subsequent construction work

news.title: Optimix's Zhuhai Production Base Receives 2026 Zhuhai ‘Green Factory’ Verification
news.excerpt: The verification recognises the Zhuhai production base's progress in sustainable and intelligent manufacturing.
news.imageAlt: Optimix Zhuhai production base recognised as a Green Factory
news.lede: Optimix's Zhuhai Green and Smart Production Base has been recognised as a 2026 Green Factory by the Zhuhai Industry and Information Technology Bureau.
body: The municipal verification assesses intensive land use, safer raw materials, clean production, resource utilisation and low-carbon energy consumption. Optimix reports that the Zhuhai base was one of 18 enterprises selected across the city.

The Industry 4.0 facility combines automated production lines, computer-controlled batching, AGVs and a warehouse management system. Its on-site laboratory has also been recognised as a Standardised Laboratory for Ready-Mixed Mortar.

The base includes a 600 kW rooftop photovoltaic system and an energy management platform for monitoring water, electricity and gas. Optimix positions the verification as a further step in reducing the environmental impact of construction-material manufacturing.
highlights: 300,000 t annual capacity reported for the base

news.title: Optimix Advances New Quality Productive Forces in Dialogue with The Hon Ray Wong Wing-wai, MH
news.excerpt: A dialogue on innovation, advanced manufacturing and the next stage of construction materials.
news.imageAlt: Optimix industry dialogue with The Hon Ray Wong Wing-wai
news.lede: The Hon Ray Wong Wing-wai, MH visited Optimix's Zhuhai Smart Manufacturing Plant for an exchange on advanced manufacturing and sustainable industrial development.
body: The plant tour introduced Optimix's automated production lines, green-building features and approach to precision, consistency and productivity. CEO Calvin Chan led the visit and outlined the facility's operating model and long-term development direction.
The discussion covered industrial upgrading, digitalisation and possible applications of artificial intelligence in production and operational management.
Optimix describes the Zhuhai plant as part of a future-ready manufacturing model that combines technology investment, talent development and environmental responsibility.

news.title: New World Qingyuan Hotel: Creating a Natural Vacation Ambiance with Green Building Materials
news.excerpt: Optimix material solutions support waterproofing, substrate preparation and tile installation across the hotel project.
news.imageAlt: New World Qingyuan Hotel completed interior
news.lede: Optimix supplied a coordinated material solution for waterproofing, substrate preparation and tile installation at New World Qingyuan Hotel.
body: The resort project uses Optimix products across bathrooms, washrooms, pantry zones and back-of-house areas where waterproofing and durability are central requirements.

TA328S tile adhesive and TG410ES tile grout were selected alongside BP138 base plaster and WP515 waterproofing slurry. The source article identifies environmental certifications held by the selected tiling products.
The case demonstrates how product selection can connect environmental objectives with maintainable wet-area and high-use construction details.
